01 / Your brief

What your vehicles need to say.

When a van is serving, customers should still see the name and understand what’s on offer from the queue. Use the wrap for your permanent identity and keep frequently changing menus and prices on a separate surface. See our van wraps in Norwich for partial and full coverage options.

03 / Recommended package

A printed full wrap for a trading vehicle

Use a full wrap when photography or illustration needs to carry across the body. A partial wrap works when your base colour already suits the brand.

05 / Design tips

Build the layout around the job.

01

Design for the open hatch

Check the proof with the hatch shown in its serving position.

02

Leave menus easy to update

Reserve a separate board or changeable panel for prices and seasonal offers.

03

Check image quality at scale

Supply original product photography and make sure it still reads at queue distance.
